motionTemplates.name: Lower third
motionTemplates.description: A name and role over the video: an accent bar grows, the name rises out of a line and the role slides in; it holds and leaves the same way.

motionTemplates.name: Title card
motionTemplates.description: A full-frame chapter or opening title: a kicker line, a headline that rises line by line, a rule that draws and a subtitle, over a softly moving backdrop.

motionTemplates.name: Bar chart
motionTemplates.description: Compares values: bars grow one after another with their numbers counting up; one bar can be highlighted. Horizontal bars suit long labels, columns suit time series.

motionTemplates.name: Donut chart
motionTemplates.description: Parts of a whole: each slice sweeps in after the last, the total counts up in the middle and a legend with shares rises beside it.

motionTemplates.name: Line chart
motionTemplates.description: A trend over time: gridlines draw, the line traces left to right under a soft fill, points pop in as it passes and the last value is called out.

motionTemplates.name: Big number
motionTemplates.description: One number that matters: it counts up large while a ring fills to the share (when it is a percentage), with a label and a line of context.

motionTemplates.name: Key numbers
motionTemplates.description: Two to four figures side by side on cards that rise in turn, each counting up with its label.

motionTemplates.name: Callout
motionTemplates.description: Points at something in the footage: a pulsing marker at the target, a leader line that draws to a label with a value. Place the target where the thing is (shares of the frame).

motionTemplates.name: Timeline
motionTemplates.description: Milestones in order: a line draws across, each point pops in with its date above and a label below.

motionTemplates.name: Checklist
motionTemplates.description: A titled list whose items slide in one by one, each ticked off as it lands.

motionTemplates.name: Quote
motionTemplates.description: A pull quote: a large quotation mark drops in, the lines rise one by one and the attribution slides in under a short rule.

motionTemplates.name: Sliding panels
motionTemplates.description: Three coloured panels sweep across and off again; the cut happens underneath while the frame is covered. Place it centred on a cut.

motionTemplates.name: Iris
motionTemplates.description: Rings expand from a point to fill the frame, then open out from the centre onto the next shot.

motionTemplates.name: Diagonal stripes
motionTemplates.description: Slanted stripes shoot across one after another until the frame is covered, then carry on off the other side.

motionTemplates.name: Blocks
motionTemplates.description: A grid of squares pops in from one corner to cover the frame and shrinks away towards the other.

motionTemplates.name: Subscribe reminder
motionTemplates.description: A subscribe button in a corner: it pops in, a cursor glides over and clicks it, the button turns to Subscribed with a tick and the bell rings; it slides away at the end.

motionTemplates.name: Kinetic words
motionTemplates.description: Short words slam in one after another (a scale punch with a blur, a flash and a small shake), each ending in an accent mark; a rule draws under them and they lift away. For openers and slogans.

motionTemplates.name: Route map
motionTemplates.description: A journey between two places on a map-style grid: the start pin drops, a dotted route draws across with a travelling dot, the destination pin lands and a distance label pops at the top of the arc.

motionTemplates.name: Chapter progress
motionTemplates.description: Where the viewer is in the video: a bar split into chapters along the top (or bottom) edge, the chapters done filled, the current one filling, with its number and title beside it.
